ModMetaData.author: Elemental Hearts
ModMetaData.description:
ASCEND. TEACH. EVOLVE.
Elemental Hearts is an intentionally powerful sword-combat and progression mod for humanlike pawns. Manifest bound swords and indestructible armor, chain animated techniques, train disciples and unlock evolved lineages.
13 PLAYABLE FORMS Lightning > Thunderstorm: electrical shocks, red lightning and Tempest Dragon dash chains. Flame > Azure Flame: thermal sword forms, blue fire and a reactive retreat/rush. Wind > Cyclone: Flow combos, precise footwork and bounded airbound finishers. Water > Glacial: Pressure, frontal parries/counters and a five-second crowd freeze. Earth > Adamant: Resolve, ground stabs, seismic circles and spiked-hill impacts. Lunar > Eclipse: rare moonlit sword forms evolving into six black/crimson techniques. Real eclipses grant Celestial-tier core stats; surrounded combat can call a temporary native eclipse. Celestial: a standalone sovereign with six solar/light techniques, Fake Rainbow, random Bestow and free manual world-map Light Travel.
THE SEVERED COURT Enemy faction: adult humanlike Oathling disciples, normal Court Knights and five evolved Heralds: Azure, Storm, Frost, Gale and Adamant. Heralds wear one distinctive elite obsidian/ivory outfit, crimson cloak and open-brow faceguard. Each retains its five evolved techniques, sword, stats and combat halo. Ten Court backstories, elemental map-name badges and mixed squads give the order its own identity. Ordinary walking raids begin from day 30; rare Herald squads require day 60 and 8,000 points, with at most one commander and sixteen total pawns. Herald’s Writ warns of an assault two days ahead. A Broken Oath offers sanctuary to a disciple, with a warned ordinary pursuit if accepted. Pending stories save safely. Settings control raids, Heralds, stories, badges and one-time existing-world introduction. Five permanent strongholds each contain a Herald, two Knights, six Oathlings, a fortified compound and a finite treasury. Dedicated Herald Assault and Stronghold Dossier events connect them to the campaign. Dispatches originate from surviving strongholds; clearing a base prevents its future expeditions. Recruits renounce the Severed Oath and regain normal elemental apparel while retaining powers and swords. Existing worlds can add the five new strongholds once on load or with the settings button, preserving other settlements and cleared bases. Lunar/Eclipse Court bosses remain planned.
PROGRESSION Acquire serum or receive power through teaching/Bestow. Normal Ascendants teach three-second paired lessons; disciples can call their own swords. Ascend unlocks at 50 credited kills and five disciple days. Evolution unlocks at 150 mastery kills and ten Ascendant days. Both use interruptible animated ceremonies. Evolved Bestow grants the matching normal lineage directly. Celestial Bestow grants Lunar at 2%, or one of the five ordinary elements at 19.6% each, and fulfills future evolution milestones. It never grants Celestial. Press Evolve when ready.
COMBAT AND DAMAGE Normal elements have four combat techniques, their evolutions five, Lunar five, and Eclipse/Celestial six. Use skills manually or choose Auto Combat: On / Off / Non-lethal. New disciples and Ascendants start with automation enabled. Draft transformed player pawns to fight and display auras/halos. The lineage Melee damage stat is a multiplier, not fixed ability damage. Techniques use the current melee profile, their own coefficients and combo bonuses. Eligible physical/elemental injury packets receive the existing shared 20% damage reduction once. For example, a normal lineage's x2 melee stat becomes x1.6 for an otherwise identical eligible physical packet before armor and other modifiers. Health-condition descriptions explain each tier; the README includes the complete damage table.
ALLIED SYNCHRONIZATION Two allied transformed Ascendants striking the same enemy within four seconds and eight clear cells gain brief shared melee/movement bonuses. Flame/Wind strengthens one existing hit, Water/Lightning can discharge, Water repairs ordinary injuries, and Earth shares protection. Celestial and eclipse-empowered Eclipse grant stronger synchronization. Each participant has one shared six-second cooldown. No additional skill-menu commands; enabled by default in mod settings. Adamant uses the standard evolved combat tier, below Eclipse and Celestial.
BOUND GEAR AND PASSIVES Transform/Revert smoothly manifests or stores each kit and restores personal clothing. Downing/death removes projected gear; recovery or revival retains ownership. Evolved outfits use fitted regal silhouettes, native west mirroring and subtle drafted halos. Carrying capacity, caravan contributions, recovery and elemental resistances scale with the lineage. Ascendants resist illness/food poisoning; evolved lineages resist Melee Animation's specific knockout condition.
NPC DISCIPLES New eligible adult humanlike NPCs from other factions have a configurable 20% disciple chance. They use automatic combat and bound gear. Each disciple receives one saved 5% near-death combat awakening roll; success heals ordinary injuries and triggers a shockwave with three seconds of heavy protection.
REQUIREMENTS AND COMPATIBILITY RimWorld 1.6 and Harmony. No DLC required. Melee Animation sword profiles and Search and Destroy support are optional. No Milira or VEF dependency. Effects use bounded pools, cached materials and local target searches. These powers do not permanently reshape terrain or damage buildings; an actual summoned eclipse changes the local sky and solar conditions.
God Mode exposes DEV: Ascend-Ready and DEV: Evolution-Ready for eligible pawns; developer mode alone does not. Disabling God Mode hides them. These commands unlock the normal Ascend/Evolve action rather than applying it.
See the GitHub README for screenshots, acquisition, the complete roster, controls, progression, damage explanations and compatibility notes.
